text:
maria: Hey folks — I pushed the changes for #3245 and addressed the earlier comments. PTAL when you get a sec. I renamed the confusing var, added the smoke test, and squashed the fixups. CI is currently flaky on the Windows job though.
maria: Quick diff of the main change:
```
- if (items.len > 0) handle(items)
+ if (!items.empty()) handle(items)
```
josh: Thanks — on it. I can skim now, but if CI is red I might wait for green before a full approve.
sam: Saw the test added, looks good. Small nit: can we use `batchLimit` instead of `limit` for clarity? not a blocker.
maria: Good call, renamed to `batchLimit` and pushed. Also re-enabled the kvcache smoke that was accidentally commented out.
ci-bot: Build started for branch: feature/pr-3245 — jobs: linux, macos, windows
olivia: reading through, nothing blocking from me. one tiny style nit inline, will comment.
josh: I ran the unit tests locally — all green for me. the windows flake looks like a known timeout, retriggering CI now.
ci-bot: Build retriggered by josh — queued.
olivia: lgtm after the style nit is fixed. feel free to merge once CI is green and @sam gives approval for the naming change.
sam: gave a quick glance — `batchLimit` makes sense. approve from me after CI green.
ci-bot: Build succeeded for branch: feature/pr-3245 — all jobs green
josh: approving now. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all! merging into main and scheduling canary for 15:00 PT. will watch metrics and rollback if error rate > 1%.
olivia: :thumbsup: ping if you need a hand with canary monitoring dashboards.
maria: will do. If anything weird pops up I'll post in #eng-oncall and tag @oncall.
